reviews.t: I went from feet like doggie pads

reviews.t: very easy to slip off the area you are buffing and ...
reviews.x: The tool is well made, but not what I expected. Had to return, this is definitely for professional use. In my opinion, It is much too powerful for a home pedicure. It is difficult to use this on yourself and very, very easy to slip off the area you are buffing and cut healthy skin. I usually remove the calluses from my feet every other week and go to a salon once a month for a pedicure. I thought this would make the job easier, but, I will go back to my old routine. It's much safer.

claims.text: Reviewers widely report the device effectively smooths dry, cracked, callused feet and delivers noticeable results.
Several reviewers describe the device as powerful and caution that it should be used carefully, especially by inexperienced users.
Users find the device easy to hold and convenient to use at home compared with salon visits or manual tools.
Some reviewers note that misuse or being too aggressive can cause burned or bloody skin.
